value.pmKisanModalSnippet:
Scheme Application Blueprint
PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
How to Apply (Online / CSC):
Visit pmkisan.gov.in > Click 'New Farmer Registration' > Enter Aadhaar & State > Fill land parcel details > Submit for Patwari/State verification.
Required Documents:
Aadhaar Card
Land Ownership Documents (Khatauni / Jamabandi / RoR)
Aadhaar-Linked Active Bank Passbook
Mobile Number linked with Aadhaar OTP
Visit Official PortalClose
